value.note: Short stem: je parais, tu parais, il paraît (circumflex on the il form).
Intercalated -iss-: nous paraissons, vous paraissez, ils paraissent.
je paraissais; the participle paraissant is attested.
je paraîtrai (circumflex on the i); conditional je paraîtrais.
que je paraisse.
Irregular past participle paru (attested); the passé simple stem is paru- (je parus).

evidence.notes: Irregular 3rd-group -aître verb; the participle paru and the present participle paraissant are attested, supporting the parai-/paraiss-/paraîtr-/paru- set.

value.note: je parie, ils parient (to bet).
nous parions, vous pariez (the i of the stem is kept).
je pariais; the participle pariant is attested.
je parierai; also conditional je parierais.
que nous pariions (double i before the ending).

evidence.notes: Regular 1st-group -ier verb; the stem keeps its i throughout, with ii in the nous/vous imperfect and subjunctive forms.

value.note: je parle, ils parlent (all attested).
nous parlons, vous parlez (attested).
je parlais (attested); the participle parlant shows the same stem.
je parlerai.
que je parle.

evidence.notes: Fully regular 1st-group -er verb; the full present and imparfait paradigms plus the imperative are attested in related_context.

value.note: je partage, ils partagent, vous partagez.
-ger verb: e retained before -ons to keep /ʒ/ (source attests nous partageons).
ils partageaient (attested); the participle partageant shows the same change.
il partagea (attested), with the extra -e- before the -a of the ending.
je partagerai; also conditional je partagerais.
que nous partagions; the singular subjunctive shares the partag- stem of the present.

evidence.notes: Regular 1st-group -ger verb; sources attest nous partageons, il partagea and ils partageaient, confirming the partag-/partage- alternation.

value.note: Short singular stem: je pars, tu pars, il part (all attested).
nous partons, vous partez, ils partent (attested).
je partais (attested); the participle partant shows the same stem.
je partirai (attested); conditional je partirais.
que je parte (attested).
Past participle parti, with être in compound tenses (attested); the passé simple je partis uses the part- stem.

evidence.notes: Irregular 3rd-group -ir verb taking être; every stem is corroborated by the full conjugation tables in related_context (par-/part-/partir-/parti-).
